response.sql: WITH filtered_labs AS (SELECT l.ID, l.PT, l.ALP, l.GPT, p.SEX FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NULL OR l.`U-PRO` != '-'), patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(ALP / GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered_labs GROUP BY ID, SEX) SELECT COALESCE(SEX, '') AS SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt, AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_avgs GROUP BY SEX ORDER BY SEX
